property_setters.value:
1. Acknowledge the PO & inform us changes, if any, within 2 days after which it will be assumed as accepted as it is.
2. Send Test Certificate/Inspection Report compulsorily with each invoice.
3. Kindly mention our PO No. and PO Date on the Delivery Challans/Invoice.
4. Please send Invoice copy and EWay Bill alongwith material.
5. This PO is valid for 30 days.
6. Free replacement against any manufacturing defect.
7. Order is confirmed on the above rate. Company is not liable to pay more rates.
8. Tax invoices for payment to be sent to our correspondence address and copy to email : aparna.patil@spconcare.com, admin@spconcare.com
